**Project:** EMFAF-2025-PIA-FisheriesScientificAdvice · Proposal 101241455  
**Duration:** 24 months (Sep 2025 – Aug 2027)  
**Total budget:** ~€599k (80% EU co-funding)

---

## Work Package 2

WP2 (User requirements, data formats and meta-data) is led by Einar Hjörleifsson (subcontracted
to DTU Aqua) and runs from M1–M12 (Sep 2025 – Aug 2026). Its deliverables are:

| Deliverable | Description | Due | Status |
|-------------|-------------|-----|--------|
| [D2.1](deliverables/D2.1_user_requirements.qmd) | User requirements document | M6 (Feb 2026) | ✅ Complete |
| [D2.2](deliverables/D2.2_data_formats_metadata.qmd) | Data formats and meta-data | M11 (Jul 2026) | 🔶 Draft |
| [D2.3](deliverables/D2.3_imbus_product_specification.qmd) | Integrated data product (R-binary and parquet) | M12 (Aug 2026) | 🔶 In progress |
| D2.4 | Data product on ICES web portal | M12 (Aug 2026) | 🔴 Pending |

The technical implementation of WP2 is in the R package
[{obus}](https://github.com/einarhjorleifsson/obus).

---

## Rendering to Word (for Sharepoint)

Individual deliverables can be rendered to Word format:

```bash
# From the imbus/ directory
quarto render deliverables/D2.2_data_formats_metadata.qmd --to docx
```

This produces `deliverables/D2.2_data_formats_metadata.docx` suitable for upload to the IMBUS
Sharepoint.
